info.description: A coach profile. Includes photo, bio, specialities, disciplines, and social links.

content-manager.label: URL Slug
content-manager.description: URL path segment, auto-generated from the title. E.g. "our-classes" → /our-classes.

content-manager.label: Role / Title
content-manager.description: Job title shown on the coach card, e.g. "Head Boxing Coach".

content-manager.label: Full Biography
content-manager.description: Full biography with rich text formatting.

content-manager.label: Short Bio
content-manager.description: Brief bio for card previews — 1 to 2 sentences.

content-manager.label: Years of Experience
content-manager.description: Total years of coaching or competition experience.

content-manager.label: Specialties
content-manager.description: Key skills or techniques — enter one per line.

content-manager.label: Disciplines
content-manager.description: Martial arts or training styles taught by this coach.

content-manager.label: Head Coach?
content-manager.description: Mark as Head Coach to feature this person prominently on the Coaches page.

content-manager.label: Sort Order
content-manager.description: Lower numbers appear first in listings. Items with the same number are sorted alphabetically.

content-manager.label: SEO Settings
content-manager.description: Search engine optimisation settings for this page.
